title: RxnScape: From Reactive Molecular Dynamics to Interpretable Reaction Pathways and Networks
description: RxnScape converts reactive molecular dynamics trajectories into chemically interpretable, traceable reaction events, pathways, and networks. It reconstructs connectivity-defined molecular states and their atom-mapped transformations, and preserves links to participating atoms, trajectory frames, and bond changes.
